WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS distinct_sites
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
all_status_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_rates
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT sr.avg_rate, sr.distinct_sites, aa.overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_rates AS sr
  CROSS JOIN all_status_avg AS aa
  WHERE aa.overall_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.avg_rate > aa.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(distinct_sites) AS average_distinct_sites,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM above_avg;
